title: [Bug] Bedrock - Claude 3.7 Failing w/ValidationException
body:
### 📦 Platform

Self hosting Docker

### 📦 Deploymenet mode

server db(lobe-chat-database image)

### 📌 Version

v1.65.0

### 💻 Operating System

Ubuntu

### 🌐 Browser

Chrome

### 🐛 Bug Description

Requests to Bedrock -> Claude 3.5 and other models works fine. Requests to Claude 3.7 work fine via console/playground. Requests to Claude 3.7 via Lobe fail with:

```
{
  "error": {
    "body": {
      "attempts": 1,
      "requestId": “1234343-4343434-43434”,
      "httpStatusCode": 400,
      "totalRetryDelay": 0
    },
    "type": "ValidationException",
    "message": "Invocation of model ID anthropic.claude-3-7-sonnet-20250219-v1:0 with on-demand throughput isn’t supported. Retry your request with the ID or ARN of an inference profile that contains this model."
  },
  "region": "us-west-2",
  "provider": "bedrock"
}
```

### 📷 Recurrence Steps

Make any call to Bedrock -> Claude v3.7 after confirming access to the model via AWS console.

### 🚦 Expected Behavior

_No response_

### 📝 Additional Information

_No response_
